thread:
kai nguyen: Quick proposal — add two things to the console + SDK headers to make client-visible degradations actionable: a 'quota-burn' indicator (how close the tenant is to route budget) and a 'soft-fail' / degraded-route badge that explains whether we fell back for cost/capacity/quality.

marta lopez: sounds useful. how noisy will this be? we already have a bunch of banners. :grimacing:

kai nguyen: Agree on noise risk. My idea: only surface the badge when > 5% of requests for a route in a 5m window used a fallback path OR when quota burn > 80% of committed budget. Otherwise keep it in the route diagnostic panel.

omar singh: nit: can we expose this through headers so SDKs can show an inline hint? e.g. `X-Redwood-Fallback` or `X-Redwood-Budget`?

jess carter: +1 to headers, but we need a privacy filter. No tenant ids in headers. Use sampled trace id and compact reason tags.

lina s.: telemetry side: we should emit `fallback.path` (string), `fallback.reason` (enum), `fallback.sample_id` (64bit hex), and `fallback.cost_delta` (tokens * cost/token). These let us build a per-tenant heatmap on the console.

kai nguyen: Proposal for header format (compact, parseable):

```
X-Redwood-Fallback: p=model-v1|m=model-v2;r=quota;tr=4f5c9a
X-Redwood-Budget: route=chat.generate;burn=82;window=5m
```

Fields: p = path (pipe-delimited model chain), r = reason (quota|capacity|quality|policy), tr = sampled trace id (no tenant info). Budget header is optional and rate-limited (once per 30s) to avoid header spam.

marta lopez: header naming ok. console UX: let's avoid the word "quota" as scary — UX copy idea: "Budget nearing limit" vs "Using lower-capacity route". colors: yellow for budget, orange for degraded.

omar singh: technical Q: if we route to cheaper model for cost, do we mark reason=quota or reason=cost? Customers will read differently. Suggest reason=budget (umbrella) and a separate tag `cost_saving=true`.

jess carter: On A/B and rollout side we need to ensure experiments don't get double-counted as fallbacks. Add `fallback.is_experiment=true` when route chosen by rollout gate.

lina s.: Dashboard metrics to add: `fallback_rate_by_route`, `fallback_cost_delta_sum`, `budget_burn_pct`, and `fallback_latency_p50/p95`. Also a small diagnostic table: (route, fallback_rate, dominant_reason, sample_traces_link).

kai nguyen: Draft console badge text: "Degraded route — lower-throughput model in use" and secondary line: "Reason: Budget (82% of committed) — see diagnostics".

marta lopez: or split: Badge primary: "Budget high" (hover -> "Requests are routed to alternate model to maintain latency budget"). Secondary badge for quality degradations: "Quality degraded" (hover before clicking for details).

omar singh: Implementation outline: 1) Emit headers from routing layer. 2) Store sampled traces and reason tag in metrics + short trace log (24h). 3) Console consumes sampled traces + budget metrics and shows badge. 4) SDK surfaces inline hint if `X-Redwood-Fallback` present.

jess carter: Security check: ensure sampled traces redact prompt/content and don't leak PII. Only include model names and trace ids.

lina s.: For telemetry ingestion we should add these tag values to our OTLP pipeline and a fallback index with TTL=7d for quick diagnostics.

kai nguyen: Example console diag snippet (proto):

```
fallbacks:
 - route: chat.generate
   fallback_rate: 0.12
   dominant_reason: budget
   sample_trace: /traces/4f5c9a
   cost_delta_usd: "$0.03"
```

Small, actionable.

marta lopez: UX follow-ups: write microcopy for banner, tooltip, and the diagnostic panel. Keep banners collapsible and only auto-open for >20% fallback rate for >10m.

omar singh: Ops question: do we want automatic remediation suggestions? e.g. "Increase reserved capacity" or "raise per-route budget" CTA from console?

jess carter: Yes but gated. Suggest CTA opens a prefilled RFC in the billing/commits workflow rather than auto-scaling without consent.

Action items:
- kai: file RFC w/ header format + sample telemetry payloads (I'll do today)
- lina: add metrics skeleton to OTLP ingestion (week).
- marta/jess: draft UX copy and banner rules (this week).
- omar: update SDKs to display inline hint when header present (P0-ish).

infra-bot: RFC created: RHW-1283 — "Soft-fail / Budget signals: headers + console badges" (link: https://go/repo/RHW-1283). Assigned: kai. :white_check_mark:
